jobs.title: Investor Relations
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate, infrastructure, private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM.

Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on lower mid market European buyout investments, raising over €430m. The fund operates out of London and focuses on investments in founder and family owned companies in B2B Services and Education across the UK and the DACH regions.

Your role

As part of a team of 12 professionals, you will be responsible for Investor Relations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Building and maintaining working relationships with Pictet's Wealth Management (PWM) relationship managers and Asset Management (PAM) sales staff across the network, understanding their client books, distribution priorities, and the broader Pictet product shelf;

• Proactively identifying and developing relationships with Limited Partners (LPs) and co-investment prospects — leveraging existing relationships within Pictet to do so;
 • Runing a regular engagement calendar of product briefings, market updates, Q&A sessions, and bilateral meetings with distribution partners and LPs;
 • Managing LP relationships through the full fund cycle — from first meeting through commitment, onboarding, ongoing reporting, and re-ups;
 • Knowing the portfolio in sufficient depth to hold detailed investor conversations on any company without requiring a member of the senior investment team to be present;
 • Owning all investor-facing materials — pitch deck, DDQ, LP updates, fund profile — working closely with PAA Marketing and Communications to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with PAA brand guidelines;
 • Maintaining DealCloud as the primary record of LP relationships and pipeline; use AI tools (Claude, Copilot) in materials drafting, research, competitor tracking, and preparation.

Your profile

• Minimum 7 years' experience in investor relations, product specialist, or distribution within private equity, private credit, or private markets;
• Direct experience working with private banking or wealth management distribution channels and managing LP relationships through the full fund cycle;
• Financially literate — able to discuss fund performance, portfolio company financials, and return attribution with confidence;
• Experience with DealCloud or a comparable CRM platform will be preferred; strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, accurate investor-grade documents is required.
• Credible with senior counterparts — PWM bankers, institutional allocators, and private clients; builds rapport naturally, follows through consistently, and navigates a multi-boutique, multi-stakeholder environment effectively
• Genuinely passionate about private equity and the underlying investment strategy, with the ability to convey the investment story with conviction to clients and prospects; French language capability preferred but not required.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal des risques et de la conformité

jobs.description:
Your team

The Operations division is responsible for the secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment fund activities. To support this mission, the Risk & Compliance – Operations team identifies, assesses and mitigates operational risks while ensuring compliance with internal policies and applicable regulations.

To bolster our team, we are seeking a Senior Risk & Compliance Manager with a strong background in banking operational risk and compliance, and the ability to lead major risk initiatives across Banking Operations. Experience in safeguarding cryptoassets, as well as expertise in data management, data analysis or data science for process optimisation and reporting, would be a valuable asset.

Your role

• to support the identification and analysis of emerging operational risk trends.

• to periodically review operational risk appetite and tolerance, develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and monitor their effectiveness.

• to coordinate and contribute to the RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) process for Banking Operations.

• to provide advisory support to the first line of defence on operational risk matters and handle specific operational compliance requests.

• to drive key risk projects and action plans within Banking Operations, ensuring timely delivery and escalation where needed.

• to use data management and data analysis skills to enhance risk monitoring, reporting and decision-making processes.

• to receive, log and monitor operational incidents, and oversee root-cause analysis and administrative follow-up.

• to monitor risk and incident mitigation plans and track the implementation of audit recommendations.

• to prepare clear, concise risk reports and presentations for governance bodies and central functions.

• to promote a strong risk culture through training, workshops and awareness activities.

• to maintain regular contact with risk managers and compliance officers across business lines, divisions and Group entities abroad.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Business, Law or Economics, or professional qualification deemed equivalent.

• At least five to eight years’ relevant experience in operational risk, compliance or audit at a mid-sized or large bank or financial institution.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior management.

• Proven ability to lead projects successfully.

• Excellent analytical skills and keen attention to detail; proficiency in MS Office/Excel; knowledge of Tableau would be an asset.

• Sound knowledge of data management, data analysis or data science, and their application in process optimisation, risk reporting or automation, would be highly desirable.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written), with at least C1 level or equivalent in each language.

• Must be resident in Switzerland.

Ref. SRCM/CRO/AS

La tua squadra La divisione Operazioni è responsabile dell’elaborazione sicura ed efficiente delle operazioni bancarie e delle attività dei fondi di investimento di Pictet. Per sostenere questa missione, il team Risk & Compliance – Operations identifica, valuta e mitiga i rischi operativi garantendo nel contempo la conformità alle politiche interne e alle normative applicabili. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un Senior Risk & Compliance Manager con un forte background nel rischio operativo bancario e la conformità, e la capacità di condurre importanti iniziative di rischio attraverso operazioni bancarie. L'esperienza nella salvaguardia dei criptoasset, così come la competenza nella gestione dei dati, nell'analisi dei dati o nella scienza dei dati per l'ottimizzazione e la segnalazione dei processi, sarebbe un bene prezioso. Il tuo ruolo
• sostenere l'identificazione e l'analisi delle tendenze dei rischi operativi emergenti.
• per rivedere periodicamente l'appetito e la tolleranza del rischio operativo, sviluppare indicatori di rischio chiave (KRIs) e monitorare la loro efficacia.
• coordinare e contribuire al processo RCSA (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) per le operazioni bancarie.
• fornire supporto consultivo alla prima linea di difesa in materia di rischi operativi e gestire specifiche richieste di conformità operativa.
• guidare progetti di rischio chiave e piani di azione all'interno delle operazioni bancarie, assicurando la consegna tempestiva e l'escalation, se necessario.
• utilizzare le capacità di gestione dei dati e di analisi dei dati per migliorare il monitoraggio dei rischi, il reporting e i processi decisionali.
• per ricevere, registrare e monitorare gli incidenti operativi, e supervisionare l'analisi causa radice e il follow-up amministrativo.
• monitorare i piani di mitigazione dei rischi e degli incidenti e monitorare l'attuazione delle raccomandazioni di audit.
• preparare rapporti chiari e concisi sui rischi e presentazioni per gli organi di governance e le funzioni centrali.
• promuovere una forte cultura del rischio attraverso la formazione, i workshop e le attività di sensibilizzazione.
• per mantenere il contatto regolare con i responsabili del rischio e gli agenti di conformità attraverso linee aziendali, divisioni e entità di Gruppo all'estero. Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in finanza, affari, diritto o economia, o qualifica professionale considerata equivalente.
• Almeno cinque o otto anni di esperienza rilevante nel rischio operativo, nel rispetto o nell’audit di un istituto bancario o finanziario di medie dimensioni o di grandi dimensioni.
• Forte gestione degli stakeholder e influenzando le competenze, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con la gestione senior.
• Prove capacità di condurre i progetti con successo.
• Competenze analitiche eccellenti e attenzione ai dettagli; competenza in MS Office/Excel; conoscenza di Tableau sarebbe un bene.
• La solida conoscenza della gestione dei dati, dell'analisi dei dati o della scienza dei dati, e la loro applicazione nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, nella segnalazione dei rischi o nell'automazione, sarebbe altamente auspicabile.
• Fluency in francese e inglese (spoken e scritto), con almeno C1 livello o equivalente in ogni lingua.
• Deve essere residente in Svizzera. Rif. Dein Team Der Geschäftsbereich Operations ist für die sichere und effiziente Abwicklung der Bankgeschäfte und Investmentfondsaktivitäten von Pictet verantwortlich. Um diese Mission zu unterstützen, identifiziert, bewertet und mindert das Team Risk & Compliance – Operations operationelle Risiken und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und geltender Vorschriften sicher. Um unser Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen Senior Risk & Compliance Manager mit einem starken Hintergrund in den Bereichen operatives Risiko und Compliance im Bankensektor und der Fähigkeit, wichtige Risikoinitiativen im Bankgeschäft zu leiten. Erfahrung in der Absicherung von Krypto-Assets sowie Fachwissen in den Bereichen Datenmanagement, Datenanalyse oder Data Science zur Prozessoptimierung und -berichterstattung wären ein wertvolles Gut. Deine Rolle
• Unterstützung bei der Ermittlung und Analyse von sich abzeichnenden operationellen Risikotrends.
• regelmäßige Überprüfung der operationellen Risikobereitschaft und -toleranz, Entwicklung von Schlüsselrisikoindikatoren (KRI) und Überwachung ihrer Wirksamkeit.
• Koordinierung und Beitrag zum RCSA-Prozess (Risk and Control Self-Assessment) für Bankgeschäfte.
• Beratung bei der ersten Verteidigungslinie in Fragen des operationellen Risikos und Bearbeitung spezifischer Anträge auf Einhaltung des Betriebs.
• Förderung wichtiger Risikoprojekte und Aktionspläne im Bankgeschäft, um bei Bedarf eine rechtzeitige Umsetzung und Eskalation zu gewährleisten.
• Nutzung von Datenmanagement- und Datenanalysefähigkeiten zur Verbesserung der Risikoüberwachung, der Berichterstattung und der Entscheidungsprozesse.
• Entgegennahme, Protokollierung und Überwachung operativer Vorfälle sowie Überwachung der Ursachenanalyse und der administrativen Folgemaßnahmen.
• Überwachung der Risiko- und Störungsminderungspläne und Verfolgung der Umsetzung der Auditempfehlungen.
• Erstellung klarer, prägnanter Risikoberichte und -präsentationen für Leitungsorgane und zentrale Funktionen.
• Förderung einer starken Risikokultur durch Schulungen, Workshops und Sensibilisierungsmaßnahmen.
• regelmäßige Kontakte zu Risikomanagern und Compliance-Beauftragten über Geschäftsbereiche, Divisionen und Konzerngesellschaften im Ausland hinweg zu pflegen. Dein Profil
• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Recht oder Wirtschaft oder berufliche Qualifikation als gleichwertig angesehen.
• Mindestens fünf bis acht Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in den Bereichen operationelles Risiko, Compliance oder Audit bei einer mittelgroßen oder großen Bank oder einem Finanzinstitut.
• Starkes Stakeholder-Management und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit der Geschäftsleitung zu interagieren.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Projekte erfolgreich zu leiten.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten und scharfe Liebe zum Detail; Kenntnisse in MS Office / Excel; Kenntnisse von Tableau wären ein Gewinn.
• Ein fundiertes Wissen über Datenmanagement, Datenanalyse oder Data Science und deren Anwendung in der Prozessoptimierung, Risikoberichterstattung oder Automatisierung wäre sehr wünschenswert.
• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch (gesprochen und geschrieben), mit mindestens C1 Niveau oder gleichwertig in jeder Sprache.

Votre équipe La Division des opérations est responsable du traitement sécurisé et efficace des opérations bancaires et des activités des fonds d'investissement de Pictet. Pour appuyer cette mission, l'équipe des risques et de la conformité – Opérations identifie, évalue et atténue les risques opérationnels tout en assurant le respect des politiques internes et des règlements applicables. Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous cherchons un gestionnaire principal des risques et de la conformité ayant une solide expérience en matière de risques opérationnels et de conformité bancaires, et la capacité de diriger d'importantes initiatives en matière de risques dans l'ensemble des opérations bancaires. L'expérience en matière de protection des cryptoactifs, ainsi que l'expertise en gestion des données, en analyse des données ou en science des données pour l'optimisation des processus et l'établissement de rapports seraient un atout précieux. Votre rôle
• appuyer l'identification et l'analyse des nouvelles tendances des risques opérationnels.
• examiner périodiquement l'appétit et la tolérance aux risques opérationnels, élaborer des indicateurs de risque clés et surveiller leur efficacité.
• coordonner et contribuer au processus d'autoévaluation des risques et du contrôle des opérations bancaires.
• fournir un soutien consultatif à la première ligne de défense en matière de risques opérationnels et traiter des demandes de conformité opérationnelle spécifiques.
• d'encourager les projets à risque et les plans d'action clés au sein des opérations bancaires, en veillant à ce qu'ils soient exécutés en temps opportun et qu'ils augmentent au besoin.
• utiliser les compétences en gestion des données et en analyse des données pour améliorer la surveillance des risques, les rapports et les processus décisionnels.
• de recevoir, d'enregistrer et de surveiller les incidents opérationnels et de superviser l'analyse des causes profondes et le suivi administratif.
• surveiller les plans d'atténuation des risques et des incidents et suivre la mise en oeuvre des recommandations de vérification.
• préparer des rapports et des exposés clairs et concis sur les risques pour les organes de gouvernance et les fonctions centrales.
• promouvoir une forte culture du risque par la formation, les ateliers et les activités de sensibilisation.
• maintenir des contacts réguliers avec les gestionnaires des risques et les agents de conformité des secteurs d'activité, des divisions et des entités du Groupe à l'étranger. Votre profil
• Diplôme universitaire en finance, commerce, droit ou économie, ou qualification professionnelle jugée équivalente.
• Au moins cinq à huit ans d'expérience pertinente en matière de risque opérationnel, de conformité ou de vérification dans une banque ou une institution financière de taille moyenne ou importante.
• Forte gestion des intervenants et influence les compétences, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec la haute direction.
• Capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets avec succès.
• Excellente capacité d'analyse et attention aux détails; compétence en MS Office/Excel; connaissance de Tableau serait un atout.
• Une bonne connaissance de la gestion des données, de l'analyse des données ou de la science des données, ainsi que de leur application dans l'optimisation des processus, la déclaration des risques ou l'automatisation, serait hautement souhaitable.
• Connaissance du français et de l'anglais (parlé et écrit), avec au moins un niveau C1 ou équivalent dans chaque langue.
• Il doit résider en Suisse. Réf. Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• As a client servicing agent (internal and external), playing an active role in problem solving and responding to clients promptly, in coordination with other departments.

• Responding to different requests from investors and clients to guarantee that a quality service is provided, which meets the requirements of high-end clients.

• Providing support to internal requesters (clients, fund managers and other departments).

• Being actively involved in planned/ongoing improvement projects in the Client Service team.

• As a privileged intermediary for investors and clients, providing communication to ensure that client orders are recorded without error and in compliance with the clauses of the various prospectuses and with the regulations in force.

• Participate in due diligence meetings, service reviews, Client visits as required.

Your profile

• Master’s degree in Economics or Finance

• Fluent in french and english

• Min 5 years experience in a similar function and/or working as a Transfer Agent

• In-depth understanding of investment fund administration.

• A willingness to commit to the long term, working in a department that is constantly undergoing change.

• Resistant to stress, dynamic, rigorous and showing initiative when solving problems.

• An enquiring mind with the ability to grasp new things quickly.

• A keen sense of client service and a willingness to find appropriate solutions.

jobs.description:
Your team

En tant que Responsable Fund Administration, vous pilotez la supervision globale des activités d’administration de fonds de placement de droit suisse, en assurant la qualité, la conformité et l’efficience des processus. Vous êtes le point d’entrée pour les demandes opérationnelles et de gouvernance liées aux fonds, coordonnez les activités déléguées, et accompagnez les clients internes et externes dans la réflexion et la mise en place de nouveaux fonds. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la supervision des opérations, y compris la valorisation des actifs illiquides (Private Equity), et dans l’évolution des outils et méthodes de contrôle.

Your role

• Superviser le processus de calcul de la valeur nette d’inventaire (VNI), procéder aux contrôles idoines et à la supervision des opérations déléguées.

• Assurer l’évaluation des placements y compris des actifs alternatifs et procéder à la supervision des activités préparatoires déléguées

• Contrôler et valider les commissions, frais et dividendes appliqués aux fonds, en conformité avec les prospectus et contrats.

• Préparer et revoir les clôtures annuelles et semestrielles des fonds, effectuer une revue critique des comptes, proposer les ajustements nécessaires.

• Organiser et suivre les audits des fonds (internes et externes), coordonner les échanges avec les auditeurs, répondre à leurs demandes.

• Coordonner et valider l’émission des rapports réglementaires et financiers, assurer leur diffusion auprès des parties prenantes (FINMA, clients, CA).

• Gérer toutes opérations courantes au niveau des fonds sous administration (apport ou sortie en nature, flux avec l’agent de transfert, etc)

• Assurer le suivi des statistiques BNS et veiller à la conformité des données transmises.

• Suivre la fiscalité des fonds, contrôler les déclarations et demandes de remboursement, participer à la coordination avec les autorités fiscales.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are seeking a diligent and insightful Buy-Side Analyst to join our Research team. You will conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies across developed markets, with a particular focus on consumer sectors, develop comprehensive financial models, and deliver high-conviction investment recommendations to internal stakeholders, especially portfolio managers and advisors.

Your role

• Fundamental research: Perform deep-dive research into companies, industries, and macroeconomic trends to identify mispriced securities.
• Financial modeling: Build and maintain complex, dynamic financial models to forecast future earnings and returns.
• Investment recommendations: Author investment memos and deliver actionable recommendations to Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due diligence: Conduct management interviews, attend industry conferences, and interact with sell-side analysts to gather proprietary insights.
• AI-augmented research: Design and apply AI-driven tools and workflows to accelerate idea generation, enhance pattern detection, and increase the agility and scalability of fundamental research.

Your profile

• At least 6 years of equity research experience on the buy side or sell side, ideally with multi-sector coverage; prior exposure to an Anglo-Saxon firm is a strong plus.

• Strong fundamental equity research capabilities with excellent quantitative and qualitative skills, and a first-principles-based approach to analysis and communication.

• Complete proficiency in Bloomberg and Microsoft tools.

Wir suchen einen sorgfältigen und aufschlussreichen Buy-Side-Analysten, der unserem Research-Team beitritt. Sie werden eine gründliche Grundlagenforschung zu Unternehmen in entwickelten Märkten durchführen, mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf Verbrauchersektoren, umfassende Finanzmodelle entwickeln und interne Stakeholder, insbesondere Portfoliomanager und Berater, von hoher Überzeugung überzeugen. • Grundlagenforschung: Führen Sie tiefgründige Untersuchungen zu Unternehmen, Branchen und makroökonomischen Trends durch, um falsch bewertete Wertpapiere zu identifizieren.
• Finanzmodellierung: Aufbau und Pflege komplexer, dynamischer Finanzmodelle zur Vorhersage zukünftiger Erträge und Renditen.
• Anlageempfehlungen: Verfassen Sie Investitionsmemos und geben Sie umsetzbare Empfehlungen an Pictet Wealth Management.
• Due Diligence: Führen Sie Management-Interviews durch, nehmen Sie an Branchenkonferenzen teil und interagieren Sie mit Sell-Side-Analysten, um eigene Einblicke zu erhalten.
• KI-gestützte Forschung: Entwerfen und Anwenden von KI-gesteuerten Tools und Workflows, um die Ideengenerierung zu beschleunigen, die Mustererkennung zu verbessern und die Agilität und Skalierbarkeit der Grundlagenforschung zu erhöhen. Dein Profil
• Universitätsabschluss: Master-Abschluss oder eine postgraduale Qualifikation wie ein CFA.
• Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Aktienresearch auf der Kauf- oder Verkaufsseite, idealerweise mit sektorübergreifender Abdeckung; die vorherige Exposition gegenüber einem angelsächsischen Unternehmen ist ein starkes Plus.
• Ausgezeichnete Beherrschung von geschriebenem und gesprochenem Englisch (einheimisch oder gleichwertig) und fließend oder besser geschriebenes und gesprochenes Französisch.
• Starke grundlegende Equity-Research-Fähigkeiten mit hervorragenden quantitativen und qualitativen Fähigkeiten und einem erstklassigen Ansatz für Analyse und Kommunikation.
• Hervorragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten durch Investment Memos und Research Notes sowie hervorragende Präsentationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln.
• Vollständige Kenntnisse in Bloomberg und Microsoft Tools.
• Vertrauensvoller und effektiver Benutzer von KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und ähnlichen Anwendungen, um die Forschungsproduktivität, die Generierung von Erkenntnissen und die Workflow-Effizienz zu verbessern.
• Unabhängige, intuitive, Selbststarter-Persönlichkeit mit einem starken Gefühl von Besitz und Rechenschaftspflicht.
• Starke Konzentration auf die Bereitstellung hochwertiger, umsetzbarer Ergebnisse und die Erfüllung ergebnisbasierter Erwartungen in einem anspruchsvollen Investitionsumfeld.

• Modélisation financière : Construire et maintenir des modèles financiers complexes et dynamiques pour prévoir les bénéfices et les rendements futurs.
• Recommandations d'investissement : Auteur de notes d'investissement et de recommandations à Pictet Wealth Management.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people. Pictet has been present in Hong Kong for 40 years where it employs around 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

Your role

Mission

To lead the Business Risk and Compliance Management Team (“BRCM”), executing strategic initiatives while bridging operational execution with independent risk and compliance oversight.
To bridge the gap between business and independent risk management through advisory and day-to-day controls.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership

• Lead and supervise the operations of the BRCM team, ensuring an effective first line of defense control environment for Wealth Management.

• Support Management in fostering a strong risk awareness culture.

• Represent BRCM in governance committees for local and global initiatives and projects.

• Provide regular reports to Senior Management and Group PWM Risk and Compliance Management on BRCM activities and risk-related matters.

Oversight and Operational Excellence

• Monitor both anti-money laundering and non-anti-money laundering risks, advising Senior Management on enhancements to risk controls.

• Offer guidance to the front office on matters related to anti-money laundering and other compliance issues.

• Identify all types of risks, including compliance risks; design frameworks and implement mitigation measures for Wealth Management.

• Oversee and continuously improve the efficiency of the BRCM team across all business risk and compliance processes.

• Supervise the resolution of relevant audits and inspections.

• Provide support and feedback on New Product Services (NPS), ensuring that all business risk and compliance considerations are appropriately addressed.

• Perform any other duties as assigned.

Strategic Stakeholder Management

• Build and maintain proactive, constructive relationships with business and functional stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business lines and support function leadership to ensure risk considerations are integrated into business strategy and execution.

Your profile

• University degree.

• Professional certifications in Financial Crime or AML are advantageous.

• Minimum of 15 years’ experience in anti-money laundering and non-anti-money laundering matters, preferably within Wealth Management.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to independently conduct in-depth analysis on compliance matters.

• Self-starter with a solution-oriented mindset.

• Well-organized and detail oriented.

• Effective team leader and player.

• Good presentation skills.

• Proficient in common IT applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Good working knowledge of both English and Chinese.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

As a Business Process Manager (BPM) within Reporting Services, you will play a pivotal role in driving efficiency and excellence across client reporting operations. Reporting to the Head of Reporting Services, you will act as a subject matter expert for transversal process improvements, collaborating with cross-functional teams to opti-mize end-to-end processes and deliver best-in-class client reporting solutions.

Your role

• Oversee, document, and optimize transversal processes related to client reporting, including portfolio statements, transaction advices, and performance analysis reports.
• Identify and analyse user pain points and areas for improvement, quantifying expected productivity gains and enhancing user experience.
• Collaborate with product managers, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders to align on process boundaries, dependencies, and strategic improvements.
• Conduct in-depth analysis of complex and critical incidents, supporting effective resolution and knowledge sharing across teams.
• Ensure up-to-date documentation of business rules and processes and promote process awareness and alignment across the organization.
• Assess the impact of new product launches on existing processes and participate in user acceptance test-ing (UAT) to ensure process integrity.
• Serve as the main point of contact for process-related queries and incidents, providing expert guidance and support to stakeholders.

Your profile

• University degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Proven experience in process optimization, business analysis, or project management within banking or professional services firms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex, cross-functional pro-jects.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with a collaborative and client-oriented mindset with a focus on teamwork and building relationships.
• Familiarity with client reporting processes, regulatory requirements, and digital tools is highly valued.
• Proficiency in English; German is an asset.
• Domiciled in Switzerland
Why Join Us?
• Opportunity to shape and optimize key processes in a dynamic, international banking environment.
• Exposure to strategic projects and cross-functional collaboration with senior stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate, private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM. Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on mid-market European buyout investments, raising over €430m.
As the fund is now in active deployment, we are looking to expand our origination capability and hire an Origination Professional dedicated to the DACH lower mid-market.
You will be part of a team of 13 professionals dedicated to the direct private equity fund. The team invests primarily across the UK and DACH in founder-led businesses in B2B services and education.
Your role will be based out of Zurich with frequent travel across DACH and London, where the fund is based.

Your role

As a key member of the direct private equity team, you will be responsible for generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline of proprietary acquisition opportunities in the DACH lower mid-market (€2–10m EBITDA, owner-managed businesses). The role combines direct founder outreach as well as corporate finance adviser coverage supporting the team’s thematic investment priorities, and the development of a modern origination tech stack. Your responsibilities will include:

• Direct Origination:

• Conduct structured mapping of companies within sub-sectors aligned to the fund's thematic priorities;

• Run structured multi-channel outreach to founder-led businesses;

• Travel across DACH to meet entrepreneurs, qualify opportunities against investment criteria, and nurture longer-term prospects through structured CRM-driven relationship management;

• Evaluate and deploy new origination tools to scale the firm's sourcing edge.

• Adviser & Intermediary Coverage:

• Build and maintain active dialogue with regional advisers, corporate finance boutiques and accountants who advise owner-managed businesses on exit;

• Travel regularly across DACH to meet advisers and position the fund consistently to ensure it is top of mind for upcoming sale mandates.

Your profile

• University degree from a strong institution; degree subject is secondary to drive, judgement and origination instinct.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will build “investment partnerships” with CRMs and fellow ISs to deliver clients a unique investment experience aligned to their needs and geographical specificities. You will also assist CRMs in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most suitable investment solutions available and activate non-managed accounts.

Your role

• Communicating the investment platform’s strategy and solutions to CRMs, clients and prospects.
• In conjunction with the CRMs, identify and develop new business opportunities from the existing client base as well as taking part in new marketing initiatives to help convert prospects to clients.
• Help determine clients’ needs and prepare investment/advisory proposals and portfolio reviews.
• Execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through assistants.
• Develop, sell and retain discretionary mandates and seek to centralise their management.
• Oversee ‘advisory-type’ mandates, seeking to streamline positions and exposure and ensure they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• Maintain a strong compliance culture, ensuring optimal compliance and risk management by adhering to all relevant local laws, regulatory requirements, in-house directives and procedures. Acquire the appropriate knowledge to apply these effectively and ensure fair treatment of all clients, while at the same time adhering to the mission and core values of Pictet across all activities conducted with a high degree of professional competency and awareness.
These entail:
• Full understanding of Pictet’s offering, policies and guidelines, attending relevant investment forums and presentations.
• An ability to present and defend the investment philosophy and mandate/product offering.
• Regular reviews of portfolios to monitor adherence to risk controls, compliance and client constraints.
• Investment of cash positions, review of client transactions and corporate actions.
• Full understanding of attribution of own portfolio performance.
• Developing appropriate marketing material for client communication.
• Knowledge of all available marketing documents and key resources within the Group.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree and a post-graduate degree such as a Master’s, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least ten years’ investment advisory/management experience; client-facing experience is a must.
• Fluency in Russian, English is required. French and Polish language skills are considered a plus in addition to the required languages.
• Excellent technical knowledge across asset classes, investment vehicles and the mandate/product offering.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficient, including knowledge of relevant software packages, on-line information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, , etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and used to working under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player but also able to work on one’s own.
• Cross asset class experience with solid knowledge of fixed income (EM and DM), derivatives, equities, and structured products.
• Solid understanding/experience in private equity and other alternative investments.
• Experience and understanding of thematic equities would be a strong advantage.
• Ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations.
The Cloud Platform team operates Pictet’s cloud landing zone and is the partner our engineering teams turn to when they build on it. As cloud adoption grows across Pictet’s engineering community, our goal is to help teams move faster with less friction.
As a Tech Lead in this team, you will build and operate the platform, anchor technical decisions and raise the engineering bar as we mature from automation to a self-service product.

Your role

• to operate and continuously improve Pictet’s cloud landing zone on AWS and Azure, acting as a trusted technical advisor to the engineers who build on it.

• to give advice on and work with product teams co-build cloud blueprints, turning shared patterns into reusable, self-service building blocks.

• to lead the shift from automation to a self-service platform by designing the paved path and abstraction layer that reduce internal clients’ cognitive load.

• to Act as a Tech Lead by anchoring key design decisions, mentoring engineers and setting the paved-road standards relied on by the team and its internal clients.

• to align with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and provide guidance, and building in security and good practice by default.

Your profile

• Strong software engineering skills: you write production-grade code in Python, Go or an equivalent language, and bring the discipline needed to turn automation into a maintainable self-service platform.

• In-depth expertise in infrastructure as code on AWS and/or Azure, with strong Terraform experience and, ideally, exposure to landing-zone or multi-account governance and automation.

• Solid architecture background in identity and access management, networking and integration, with the ability to reason through design choices.

• A platform-as-a-product mindset: you treat internal engineers as clients and care about adoption, self-service and the developer experience.

• Experience as a tech lead or senior individual contributor, making and guiding technical decisions for a team.

• Experience with containers, orchestration and the wider tooling ecosystem, including Kubernetes and GitHub Actions or CI/CD.

• Exposure to DevSecOps, agentic AI or FinOps practices would be an advantage.

• A team player with strong communication skills, intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn.

• Fluent English is required; French would be an advantage. Otherwise, candidates should be willing to learn it.

• Swiss resident or willing to relocate.
